svg.aria-label: Ten other robot benchmarks and RoboTeam, by robot arms on one task and how long one run can last. Every other benchmark has 1 to 4 arms and runs of at most 4 hours; RoboTeam has 16 arms and runs of up to 24 hours. Also: RoCoBench, RoboTwin, RobotWorld, RoboColiseum, ReflexBench, EmbodiedBench and VLABench.
